messages:
Emily Huang: Heads up — candidate Jordan K (SWE-2) booked for onsite Wed 2026-03-09 PT. Needs travel & day-of logistics. Can someone own travel reimbursements + airport pickup?
Ryan Cho: I can own airport pickup and day-of escort. What flight info do we have?
Emily Huang: Candidate flight: UA 417 arriving SFO 08:45 PT. Returning UA 889 dep SFO 20:10 PT. They requested hotel near SOMA.
Maria Gonzales: I'll own scheduling the panel. Please share the panel list + time windows. I have 10:00-12:30 and 14:00-17:00 PT blocked.
Ryan Cho: Noted. I'll meet them at arrivals at 09:15, take them to hotel, bring them to office at 09:50 for the 10:00 slot.
Emily Huang: @Maria Gonzales panel: Eng interviewers: Priya (backend), Sam (systems), Jordan L (infra), Izzy (product). Interview rubric link: https://redwood.okr/evals/SWE-2-rubric
Maria Gonzales: Got it. I'll float 10:00-12:30 PT to the panel and lock once everyone confirms.
interview-bot: Interview Kit generated: https://redwood.tools/kit/1742. Includes JD, rubric, candidate resume, and sample take-home notes.
Talent Ops: Candidate dietary restrictions: vegetarian. Also confirmed they need reimbursement for rideshare — please submit expenses within 30 days using the travel form: https://redwood.tools/expenses
Ryan Cho: For rideshare I'll cover pickup to hotel. Do we reimburse rides from airport to office separately?
Emily Huang: Yes — rideshare to/from airport + overnight parking if any. Keep receipts and tag with "JordanK-onsite-03-09".
Maria Gonzales: Quick timezone check for remote interviewers: Priya is PT, Sam is ET (will join 13:00 ET = 10:00 PT), Izzy is CET — she confirmed 19:00 CET which is 10:00 PT. All good.
Emily Huang: Can someone create the calendar invites with Zoom + office room (SOMA-5)? Include draft schedule: 10:00-10:45 tech1, 11:00-11:45 tech2, 12:00-12:30 lunch w/ hiring manager, 14:00-15:00 system design, 15:30-16:00 wrap + debrief buffer.
Maria Gonzales: I'll create invites and add interview kit link. Also adding buffer for commute time.
Ryan Cho: I'll DM candidate my mobile and send day-of check-in details. Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199.
Emily Huang: One more — candidate asked about onsite parking reimbursement and whether we can cover a taxi if flight delayed past 21:00. Approved — yes, escalate to Talent Ops if flight change.
Talent Ops: Noted. If flight changes, please update Greenhouse stage and ping us. I'll pre-create expense label and hotel booking code.
interview-bot: Greenhouse update suggestion: set stage to "Onsite Scheduled" and add note: "UA417 arr 08:45 — Ryan pickup; hotel SOMA; dietary: vegetarian".
Maria Gonzales: Panel confirmed. Calendar invites sent to panel + candidate. Emilys: can you confirm office room booking SOMA-5?
Emily Huang: Confirmed SOMA-5 reserved 09:45-16:30. Please use door code 4821 and badge pickup at reception.
Ryan Cho: All set on my side. I'll pickup candidate and drop at office by 09:50.
Emily Huang: Thanks all. Tagging @Talent Ops once more to handle reimbursements after interview.
Talent Ops: Will do — will follow up with candidate and email expense instructions after the visit. :white_check_mark:
